sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: No-ops AppsFlyer's start() and logEvent() entry points, so no install attribution or analytics events are sent.

Disables AppsFlyer/Facebook/Google measurement components, switches Facebook app events and Firebase/Crashlytics/Google-Analytics collection off, and removes the install-referrer permission. Push notifications are kept.

Stops Google Mobile Ads from initialising (removes the AdMob app id) and strips the advertising-ID, ad-services and install-referrer permissions. Ad slots in the Flutter UI cannot be removed, but they no longer fill.
